items.title: Harold Fannin: Limited in Wednesday's practice
items.text:
Fannin (groin) was listed as a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Ryan McFadden of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Denzel Boston: Managing quad injury
items.text:
Boston didn't practice Wednesday due to a quadriceps injury, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Mason Rudolph: Likely to start beyond Week 12
items.text:
Rudolph will start Friday's game against the Broncos and could remain atop the depth chart for the rest of the season with the Steelers waiving Aaron Rodgers on Wednesday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Juwan Johnson: Misses Wednesday's practice
items.text:
Johnson (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring/wrist issue, Katherine Terrell of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Remains limited, but expected back Sunday
items.text:
Head coach Klint Kubiak said that Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) remained a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, but the Raiders are optimistic that the tight end will play Sunday against the Browns, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
